jobs.title: IT INCIDENT MANAGER
jobs.description: Company description: Scandinavian Airlines System SAS Job description: Challenges you will work on: Some roles prevent disruption before it happens. Others take charge when it does. As Incident Manager at SAS, you will coordinate the response to major IT incidents, helping restore critical services while keeping stakeholders informed and operations moving. You will act as the central point of coordination during major incidents, bringing together technical teams, suppliers, and business stakeholders to manage critical situations effectively. In a fast-paced and business-critical environment, you will help minimize disruption, support operational stability, and drive continuous improvement across incident management processes. Success in this role requires a calm, structured, and collaborative approach, with the ability to make informed decisions and communicate clearly under pressure. Your responsibilities include: Lead and coordinate the response to major IT incidents until services are restored and stabilized. Assess business impact and urgency, ensuring the right technical teams and suppliers are engaged quickly. Facilitate incident bridges and coordinate actions, escalations, decisions, and communications throughout the incident lifecycle. Maintain focus on service restoration while supporting investigation, workaround, and recovery activities. Provide timely and audience-appropriate communication to business stakeholders, operational teams, and IT leadership. Escalate incidents to senior leadership, suppliers, and external partners when required. Ensure that incident records, timelines, decisions, and communications are accurately maintained in ServiceNow. Drive effective handover to Problem Management and support Root Cause Analysis and post-incident reviews. Monitor incident trends, recurring issues, and response performance to identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and maintain incident playbooks, communication templates, readiness exercises, and operational procedures. Contribute to strengthening SAS’ incident response capabilities and service management practices. The Team You will be part of the Service Management organization and work closely with Service Desk, IT Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Cybersecurity, and Application teams. The role involves extensive collaboration with Service Owners, Product Owners, business stakeholders, technology suppliers, and operational functions across SAS. Together, you will help ensure that critical services remain available, resilient, and capable of supporting business-critical airline operations. As SAS continues to strengthen its operational service management capabilities, effective incident management plays an increasingly important role in delivering stable and reliable technology services. To be successful we believe you have Experience managing incidents in a large, complex, and business-critical IT environment. Strong understanding of ITIL Incident Management, with working knowledge of Problem Management and Change Management. Experience coordinating multiple technical teams and suppliers during high-pressure situations. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to provide clear updates to both technical teams and senior stakeholders. The ability to make structured decisions with incomplete information and remain calm during operational disruptions. Experience working with ServiceNow or a similar IT Service Management platform. Experience from aviation, transportation, or other 24/7 mission-critical environments is considered an advantage. Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and collaboration skills. A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence. ITIL certification, or equivalent practical experience, is considered an advantage. jobs.title: Senior Operational Lead / Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description: About Norvion Systems AB Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Norvion Systems AB is an innovative engineering company dedicated to deploying cutting-edge AI, robotics, and embedded systems solutions across the Nordic region and Europe. We bridge advanced technological innovation with successful real-world deployments, serving as Europe’s trusted engineering partner. Our leadership and core technical teams comprise industry veterans and technical experts from global tech pioneers, Tier 1 suppliers, and intelligent cockpit fields. We cultivate a practical, reliable, and quality-driven Nordic engineering culture. At Norvion, you will work at the forefront of Embodied AI and advanced edge platform engineering, collaborating with top-tier research institutions and industrial leaders to push the limits of technology. The Opportunity: To ensure the seamless delivery and robust operational performance of our core enterprise systems, we are currently supporting a premier client in Gothenburg in the search for an experienced Senior Operational Lead / Service Delivery Manager. 🎯 Key Focus Areas In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical operations and business expectations, driving excellence across the following areas: Operational Excellence: Leading operational delivery, driving continuous improvements, and ensuring high-availability service delivery in a modern DevOps environment. Incident & Coordination: Orchestrating incident management, production support, and fast-paced operational coordination. Stakeholder & Customer Success: Managing complex stakeholder environments and maintaining transparent, high-level customer communication. Team Leadership: Coaching, mentoring, and guiding cross-functional teams toward operational maturity and collaborative success. 👤 Profile & Qualifications We are looking for a senior professional who thrives in dynamic environments and possesses a strong delivery mindset: Proven Leadership: Extensive experience as a Service Delivery Manager, Operational Lead, or a closely related senior operational role. Tech Ecosystem Knowledge: Hands-on understanding of DevOps environments, production support setups, and IT service management (ITSM) frameworks. Communication & Influence: Exceptional stakeholder management skills and the ability to articulate complex technical status into clear customer communications. Language Skills: Fluent in English (both written and spoken) is a mandatory requirement. Work Authorization: The legal right to work in Sweden by the project start date (or possessing an active permit that allows an immediate start without a new application process) is strongly preferred due to the August 2026 timeline. 🎁 Why Choose Norvion? A Stage to Push Boundaries: "Engineering Beyond Boundaries" — We provide direct, hands-on exposure to the future of advanced automotive systems, general-purpose robotics, and embodied intelligence. Work with Tech Experts: Collaborate closely with a highly skilled engineering team boasting deep European delivery experience. No red tape, just pure engineering excellence. Nordic Work Culture: Embrace a flexible, flat, and results-oriented environment that values work-life balance and individual growth.

jobs.title: Senior ServiceNow Consultant
jobs.description: About Cognizant Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is one of the world's leading professional services companies — an AI Builder bridging the gap between investment and enterprise value through full-stack solutions built on deep industry, process, and engineering expertise. With over 300,000 associates globally, we bring together technical excellence and a genuinely collaborative culture. Learn more at cognizant.ai. About the Role We are looking for a Senior ServiceNow Consultant to join our growing practice in Sweden. This is a role for someone who leads — not just delivers. You will own requirements gathering, solution design, and end-to-end implementation for clients across the Nordic region, working across CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and platform integrations, with the stakeholder confidence to do so independently. You will translate client needs into scalable ServiceNow architectures, design and develop integrations — including e-bonding with third-party platforms — write custom scripts and automation, and provide technical leadership across full project lifecycles. Contribution to pre-sales solutioning and effort estimation is also part of the picture. What You Bring You have solid hands-on experience with CSDM implementation and governance, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ServiceNow platform administration. Your technical toolkit includes ServiceNow integrations via REST and SOAP APIs, JavaScript scripting, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and e-bonding implementations. You are experienced in enterprise-scale environments, comfortable operating independently, and bring strong stakeholder management skills. Prior Nordic region experience is a meaningful advantage. Experience with HAM or SAM is a welcome plus. Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Swedish or Norwegian is highly desirable. Certifications Required: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) · CIS – Data Foundation Nice to Have: ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) · Additional CIS certifications Additional Information Compensation information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law. Applicants may be required to attend interviews in person or by video conference. In addition, candidates may be required to present their current state or government issued ID during each interview. Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. Your application and candidacy will not be considered based on race, color, sex, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. If you have a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening or submit an application, please email CareersNA2@cognizant.com for roles based in the Americas or CareersIndia2@cognizant.com for roles based in India.

jobs.title: Customer Service Manager Scandinavia - Kiilto
jobs.description: A hands-on Customer Service role for you who enjoy daily operations, teamwork and continuous improvement. At Kiilto, Customer Service plays an important role in creating a smooth and reliable customer experience. We are now looking for an experienced Customer Service or Supply Chain professional who enjoys working close to the daily business, leading the Scandinavian Customer Service team and helping improve common ways of working across the region. Role overview In this role, you will lead Customer Service operations for the Scandinavian region, covering Kiilto’s markets in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. You will work closely with a small, experienced team and support high-quality service throughout the order-to-cash process. The position combines coordination, daily operational work and continuous improvement. You will help set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support the team in meeting agreed service levels. You will also be involved in improving processes, systems and ways of working. You will be part of an international Logistics and Warehousing team and collaborate with colleagues in Logistics, Supply Chain, Finance and the Business Areas. The role is focused on the Scandinavian region, while also contributing to selected regional and global improvement initiatives where relevant. Your key responsibilities · Support and develop the Scandinavian Customer Service team in daily operations. · Ensure effective day-to-day Customer Service operations, including sales order management, claims handling and customer requests. · Set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support agreed service levels. · Improve and harmonize Customer Service processes and ways of working across the Scandinavian markets. · Support organizational and cultural change initiatives to enable effective cross-border collaboration. · Analyze Customer Service performance and implement corrective actions and improvements where needed. · Collaborate closely with Logistics, Warehousing, other parts of the supply chain function, Finance and Business Area teams to strengthen the overall order-to-cash process. · Contribute to regional and selected global improvement projects. What we expect · Relevant academic degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, higher vocational education (KY/YH), or equivalent experience · Several years of experience in Customer Service operations, Supply Chain or a similar area. · Experience from working in an international team and supporting or leading people in a cross-cultural environment. · Experience of leading change and developing processes, systems and ways of working. · Strong analytical skills and experience using KPIs and data to drive performance and improvement. · Good understanding of ERP systems, Office tools and BI solutions. · Strong communication and collaboration skills in an international, cross-functional environment. · Fluency in English and Swedish. Why Kiilto? At Kiilto, you will be part of a growing international family-owned company with a long-term perspective, an open culture and a strong team spirit. We value collaboration, continuous learning and opportunities to develop together with the company. Employees are encouraged to contribute ideas, take initiative and grow through Kiilto’s innovation and training programs. The role is based in Malmö, Sweden and requires regular collaboration across the Nordic region, including some travel within the Kiilto countries, mainly within the Nordics. How to apply If this opportunity sounds right for you, we look forward to hearing from you. We are partnering with Gruffman Recruitment & Consulting in this recruitment process. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we apply ongoing selection. Latest day for applying is September 14. For questions about the role, contact Ulrika Gruffman at ulrika@gruffman.nu. You will work with product deliveries across the RaySearch product suite, supporting clinics in Europe in implementing and deploying our oncology software solutions. Communicate with customers and internal stakeholders. Participate in activities to continuously improve internal processes and routines. Also, we believe that you are interested in innovative technology and curious to learn more about our products and the use and utility for our customers. You are not afraid of challenges, and you easily adapt to new situations and solve problems as they arise. Multitasking comes natural for you as you are both a strong organizer and administrator.
